30 Description: During January 2025, mercadolibre.cl and falabella.com were the shopping websites with the highest organic traffic in Chile, with approximately 11 million visitors each. The website of the South American retailer paris.cl ranked third in organic traffic
during the same month in its country of origin. In 2024, clothing was the most purchased category online in Chile. Read more
Note(s): Chile; January 2024
Source(s): Ahrefs

Description: Participation during CyberDay and CyberMonday has seen an increase in Chile since 2020. In the 2024 edition held from June 3 to 5, CyberDay had 780 participating sites. Meanwhile, CyberMonday, held from September 30 to October 2, recorded 750
participants in the same year. This is the first year that participation is higher on CyberDay than on Cyber ​​Monday. Read more
Note(s): Chile; 2020 to 2024; includes companies and foundations
Source(s): CCS

respondents were more likely to prioritize costs and transactions fees than any other country in the region. Read more

Description: According to the Statista Global Consumer Survey conducted in Chile in 2024, 30 percent of those who bought something online in the past 12 months were aged between 30 and 39 years old. Only six percent of survey respondents who shopped online
in the South American country during the previous 12 months were between 60 and 64 years old. Read more
Note(s): Chile; 18 January 2024 to 15 March 2024; 969 respondents; 18-64 years; e-commerce users*; *Persons who had bought something online in the past 12 months in one of the following categories: bags & accessories, books, movies, [...] Read more
